name: moonlightcode
description: MoonlightCode for Claude Code: workflow phases, with Plan as a read-only boundary while Claude Code runs in auto mode

reviewSkills.title: Review skills
reviewSkills.description: The review skills the Review panel offers to run, comma-separated (bare, or plugin:name). Only the installed ones are offered. A team sets its own here, e.g. through managed settings.

colorBlind.title: Colour-blind mode
colorBlind.description: Draw phases and change counts in the Okabe–Ito colours, which stay distinct for red-green and blue-yellow colour blindness. Phases keep their own symbols and severities their marks in every mode.
